name: Motiff
summary: UI design tool with built-in AI.
description: Motiff is an interface design tool similar to Figma, with AI features that generate screens, catch design inconsistencies and help maintain a design system.
features: Motiff is an AI product for design.

howToUse.title: Sign up on Motiff
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

features_fr: Motiff est un produit d'IA pour le design.

description_fr: Motiff est un logiciel de conception d'interfaces, proche de Figma, avec des fonctions IA qui génèrent des écrans, détectent les incohérences de design et aident à maintenir un design system.
